'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Ryan Freeman DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Freeman]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''ROPS'''. Line 1 Rops → [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire]]. L32 Lateral Damage (sheet kachy latz). L40 Blizzard (V) → Blizzard Scout 1 (V) (Blizz 1 already #26). R42 Dr. → Dr. Evazan; R43 Mobquet K-Y100 "Kinta" Strider (V). Shield1 K&D crossed (moved to main #60); shield8 Firepower crossed; Additional I Find Your Lack Of Faith Disturbing (V) folded in — '''11 shields''' after strikes.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
